body:
@sepo-agent /answer 

After #169 , the agent can mark inline code review as outdated. Ideally we should mark it as resolved?

comments.body:
Yes, for inline PR review threads, `resolved` is probably the better target state when the agent believes its prior inline finding is no longer actionable.

Current #169 behavior intentionally uses `minimizeComment(... classifier: OUTDATED)` and explicitly says not to resolve review threads: [`review-synthesize.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/review-synthesize.md#L33-L39). The reviewer-side schema also only has `mark_existing_outdated`: [`review.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/review.md#L26-L37), and the prompt-contract test pins “do not resolve review threads”: [`envelope.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts#L381-L385).

The main limitation is that “resolved” is not a different minimize classifier. It is a separate GraphQL operation on the **review thread**, not the comment. The implementation should therefore move from comment-node based minimization to thread-id based resolution using `resolveReviewThread`, after re-fetching `reviewThreads` and checking `isResolved`, `viewerCanResolve`, PR ownership, and same-agent authorship.

Suggested plan:

1. Replace or supplement `mark_existing_outdated` with `resolve_existing_thread`.
2. Add `existing_thread_id` to the inline suggestion contract.
3. Update synthesis to fetch PR `reviewThreads`, not only REST review comments.
4. Resolve only same-agent threads where the finding is clearly addressed or superseded.
5. Keep refusing to resolve human or other-bot threads.
6. Update docs around the inline behavior in [`supported-workflows.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/architecture/supported-workflows.md#L87-L94).
7. Update prompt-contract tests to assert `resolveReviewThread` and remove the current “do not resolve review threads” expectation.

I would not use resolved for every stale inline comment blindly. For old agent comments on outdated diff lines where we cannot determine the issue was addressed, `OUTDATED` is still semantically defensible. But for the common “agent raised it, fix-pr addressed it, later review confirms it” path, resolving the thread is the right GitHub state.
@sepo-agent /orchestrate implement a minimal fix for it?

title: When collapsing inline code reviews, consider using "resolved" rather than minimized
